theme: An open calendar, and a trip to-do list that's gone overdue.
greeting: Back on the ground in St. Pete, Dan — nothing on the calendar today, which is just as well, because the travel logistics need you before the girls arrive tomorrow at three.

needsAttention.title: Rental car for the Orlando run
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20–Oct 5 full-size SUV (p1, overdue since Sep 9) isn't a hedge anymore — you landed Sunday and tomorrow's 3 PM pickup and drive to the villa depend on it.

needsAttention.title: Reschedule the kids' passport appointment
needsAttention.detail: p1 task dated today. Before you rebook, pin down the four expired books and finish the DS-11 packet so a reschedule doesn't turn into a redo.

needsAttention.title: Buy the Disney park tickets
needsAttention.detail: The last open item for Sept 26–27, six people. Check whether your ticket type needs park reservations and whether a Halloween party night changes which park.

needsAttention.title: Plan the pickup and grocery stop
needsAttention.detail: Girls get picked up Tue 3 PM, then it's ~1.5–2 hrs to the Orlando villa. Slot a grocery run near St Pete or Orlando so the villa kitchen actually gets used.

flagged.title: LinkedIn messages awaiting a reply
flagged.detail: A couple of connections (incl. Claudia) are waiting on you — worth a pass while you're actively networking.

flagged.title: A caregiver applied on Care.com
flagged.detail: Lynsey P. applied to your posting — a quick look when you have a minute.

flagged.title: Venmo: $1,300 to Paul Singer
flagged.detail: The sailing payment cleared today — confirmation only, nothing to do.

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters and receipts — NYT Cooking, Responsible Investor, St. Pete local, a few shop promos.

recipe.title: Roasted pumpkin soup
recipe.why: Autumn squash is at its sweetest now — roasting it deepens the flavor before it goes into the pot.

tasks.title: Book the Maine Christmas rental (refundable SUV, PWM)
Call the dermatologist to book wart removal

acts.line: A clear calendar in St. Pete — no meetings on the books.
The overdue trip logistics are the real work: car, passports, Disney tickets.
The last quiet night before the girls arrive tomorrow.
